title: RCP Registry — EquipmentProfile
description: A governed equipment profile whose parameters participate in the maths (DECISIONS #3): level-1 conversions live here (e.g. convection = conventional −20°C), never hand-encoded in recipes.

kind.description: Equipment family slug: oven, mixer, vessel, mould, glassware, ice, crock…

parameters.description: Machine-read parameters (max_temperature, thermal_mass, steam, heat profile…) — must be complete for the maths this equipment participates in (registry-governance directive).

conversions.description: Level-1 parameter-shift rules relative to a reference profile.

aliases.description: Ids and raw names that consolidate into this entry (mirrors ingredient-class aliases).

superseded_by.description: On deprecated entries: the successor id (governance rule 3 — deprecate and add, never rename).
